～Chapter 3～
Kobu Tank, Roll Out!
Looks like everyone’s here.
Now let’s take a minute to review <NAME>’s report.
Kiku found one of the pieces of the Regalia, but it was stolen by an unknown entity.
What could this “entity” be?
Why did it take the Regalia?
What do they plan to do with it?
It’s just one mystery after the other.
There is, however, one thing we DO know.
There are others beside us after the Pandemonium Regalia.

Exactly.
These “Regalia” things are the key to all of this.
We have already explored every part of the Mikasa that remains above ground.
So you’re sayin’ we’re gonna have to go underground now, huh?
Underground... As if things in the Mikasa weren’t bad enough above ground already...
We probably can’t even begin to imagine what the situation is like down there.
The enemies will only get stronger the deeper down we go.
Remember this, <NAME>: you can’t solve every problem with the same skills or gear.
In other words, some monsters may be able to resist certain attacks or items.
Are you ready for this, <NAME>?
I’ll be fine.
I’m shaking in my boots.
Everything will work out.

I’ll be fine.
Leave it to me.
Stay strong, <NAME>!
Good luck, <NAME>!
... Don’t die.

O-Oh geez...
I think I’m shaking in my boots...

You’ll be fine, .
Just go for it!

You’ve got this, .
Just give it all ya got and go get ‘em!
I know you can do this, <NAME>. I’ll be supporting you every step of the way.
Well, I’m sure everything will work out, right?
My, seeing you so relaxed has actually put me somewhat at ease.
So confident, like a hawk hiding its talons!
Yes, I’m feeling less tense myself now, thanks to you.
Keep it together, <NAME>.
We’re all here for you, <NAME>, so just try your best.
Good luck, <NAME>!
Well then, <NAME>, it’s time to investigate underground beneat the Mikasa.
Good luck.
